This build fixes exactly those two complaints. It was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hoo-dles' morphe-patches v1.47.0 (not official Morphe). After GitHub blocked the hoo-dles repo, the AutoBuilds maintainer put the same bundle on Codeberg as RookieZ/campus-android-lab. It has two Pandora patches, both on by default: Disable ads for ads during audio streaming, and Unlimited skips. It doesn't turn your account into Premium, so on-demand play of any song isn't part of it.

What the Pandora patches change

Disable ads

Stops the ads that play during audio streaming on free stations.

Unlimited skips

Skip as many tracks as you want instead of hitting the free-tier limit.

Stations work as usual

Thumbs up and down still shape your stations, just as in the regular app.

No on-demand play

There's no Premium patch in the bundle. Picking any song or album to play stays locked.

How to install patched Pandora

  1. Download the APK from the box above. It's one universal file.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store Pandora first. The patched copy is signed with a different key, so Android won't install it over the original.
  3. Give your browser or file manager permission to install apps, then open the APK.
  4. Sign in with your Pandora account. Your stations live on the account, so they'll be there.

Pandora FAQ

It's built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches, now served from a Codeberg mirror because the GitHub repo is blocked. The Morphe team didn't make it, and this unofficial site only links to it. Like any modified APK it carries some risk, so install it only if you trust those sources.

No. The bundle only has two Pandora patches: no ads during playback and unlimited skips. On-demand listening and other Premium features aren't included.

Pandora's service is only offered in the US, and these patches don't change that.

Not through the Play Store. Install newer builds from this page over the existing one.

apps.name: Morphe Park4night
apps.description: park4night with TorbenStriegel's Unlock Premium patch, which lifts the Pro gates on offline maps, advanced filters and publisher content. Unofficial.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Park4night?

park4night is the app a lot of van and motorhome travellers use to find somewhere to stop for the night. It's a community map of parking spots, aires, campsites and service points, with photos and reviews from people who've stayed there. The paid tier is called park4night+.

The APK on this page was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Morphe CLI and the third-party TorbenStriegel/morphe-patches-custom bundle, not the official Morphe patches. That bundle has a single park4night patch, Unlock Premium, and it's on by default. Its description says it unlocks Pro access and lifts the gates on offline maps, advanced filters and publisher content. How well each of those works hasn't been checked here.

What the patch changes

Unlock Premium

The only patch in this build. It switches the app to Pro access, including the advanced filters and publisher content.

Offline maps

Handy where there's no signal, which is often where the good spots are. The patch lists offline maps among the Pro gates it removes.

Same spots and reviews

The places, photos and comments are the community's, loaded from park4night as usual.

Updates come from here

The Play Store won't update a re-signed app. We refresh the download links from the AutoBuilds release several times a day.

How to Install Morphe Park4night

  1. Uninstall the Play Store version of park4night if it's on your phone, because the signatures differ and Android won't let one replace the other.
  2. Download the Universal APK above.
  3. Turn on installs from unknown sources for your browser (Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps).
  4. Install it and open park4night. Sign in if you want to add places or reviews; the patch description doesn't say an account is needed for the Pro features.

Morphe Park4night FAQ

It's an unofficial build. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original park4night APK using Morphe CLI and TorbenStriegel's open-source morphe-patches-custom bundle and re-signed it. park4night and the Morphe team didn't make it. Modified APKs always carry some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

The patch description names offline maps, advanced filters and publisher content. It doesn't mention needing an account for them. Posting spots or reviews still works through your park4night account as usual.

The build only patches the premium check. Adding spots and writing reviews goes through park4night's servers like in the normal app.

apps.name: Morphe Photomath
apps.description: Photomath APK patched with the community De-Vanced bundle: Plus unlock, no update popup, spoofed device ID. Unofficial build, no root needed.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Photomath?

Photomath is the camera math solver Google now owns. You point the camera at a printed or handwritten problem and it shows the answer with the working laid out step by step. The free app covers a lot already. Photomath Plus adds the deeper explanations and extra help on top.

This build uses three patches from RookieEnough's community bundle De-Vanced, applied with Morphe CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline: Unlock plus, Hide update popup and Spoof device ID. It isn't an official Morphe build and it wasn't made by this site. We only link to it.

The three patches

Unlock plus

Makes the app treat your account as Plus on the device. Anything Photomath checks on its own servers may still want a real subscription.

Hide update popup

Re-signed apps can't update from the Play Store, so the app would keep nagging you to update. This patch stops that popup.

Spoof device ID

Reports a different device ID. According to the patch description, this is meant to make it harder for the developers to ban a device by hand.

Scanning works as usual

The camera solver, the history and the step-by-step view are the stock app. Only the three things above were changed.

How to install

  1. Uninstall the Play Store version of Photomath first. It is signed with a different key, so Android won't install this APK over it.
  2. Download the universal APK from the box above. It's the only file, so there's nothing to choose.
  3. Open it and allow installs from your browser or file manager if Android asks.
  4. Launch Photomath and grant camera access when it asks.

Photomath FAQ

It's the normal Photomath app with three patches from RookieEnough's open-source De-Vanced bundle, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It isn't from Google or the Morphe developers. It is an unofficial, modified APK, and any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

Not necessarily. The patch changes how the app sees your membership on the phone. Content that Photomath serves from its own servers can still check your real account, so some Plus extras may not load. We haven't tested each one.

The patch reports a different device identifier to Photomath. The bundle describes it as a way to reduce manual bans by the developers. It doesn't change anything you'll notice while solving problems.

That's the Hide update popup patch. The Play Store can't update this copy anyway, so new versions come from the download box on this page.

apps.name: Morphe Pinterest
apps.description: Pinterest APK built with jkennethcarino's adobo bundle and its Disable mobile ads patch. Close to the stock app. Unofficial community build.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Pinterest?

Pinterest is the visual bookmarking app: you save pins for recipes, outfits, room ideas or anything else onto boards, and the home feed keeps suggesting more of the same. Like most free apps, it also shows ads.

Here's what this build actually is. It was made with jkennethcarino's community bundle adobo and Morphe CLI, through the community AutoBuilds pipeline. adobo has no Pinterest-specific patches. The pipeline turns on just one of its general patches for this app, Disable mobile ads. So you get a Pinterest that's very close to stock. It isn't an official Morphe build.

What to expect

Disable mobile ads

The patch turns off banner, interstitial and similar ad formats that apps load through mobile ad SDKs.

Promoted Pins probably stay

Promoted Pins in the home feed are part of Pinterest's own content, not an ad SDK, so expect to keep seeing them.

Boards and pins as usual

Saving, boards, search and the feed are the regular Pinterest app.

One universal APK

There's a single universal file, so you don't need to pick a version for your phone's architecture.

Installing it

  1. Uninstall the Play Store version first. The signatures differ, so Android won't install over it. Your boards are on your Pinterest account, so they'll still be there.
  2. Download the APK from the box above.
  3. Open it and allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps if asked.
  4. Sign in to your Pinterest account.

Pinterest FAQ

It's the Pinterest app with one universal patch from jkennethcarino's open-source adobo bundle, built with Morphe CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It isn't from Pinterest or the Morphe developers. It is an unofficial, modified APK, and any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

Probably not. The only patch applied disables ads served through mobile ad SDKs. Promoted Pins come from Pinterest's own feed, so they will most likely still appear.

Because it nearly is. adobo has no Pinterest-specific patches, and the build only switches on its general Disable mobile ads patch.

apps.name: Morphe Pixiv
apps.description: pixiv with Piracola's Pixiv-Patched: ad blocker, AI work flagger, original-size downloads, local history, OLED black and search tweaks.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Pixiv?

pixiv is the Japanese art community where illustrators and manga artists post their work, and where a lot of people go to browse it. The free app shows bottom banner ads and sponsored works in feeds, and AI-generated images have become hard to avoid there.

This APK is built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Morphe CLI and Piracola/Pixiv-Patched, a third-party bundle made only for pixiv (its README is in Chinese). It isn't an official Morphe build. Twelve of the bundle's thirteen patches are on by default, and the remaining one, Popular Search Unlock, gets pulled in by Search Ranking anyway. The patches also add a Pixiv-Patched page to the side drawer where the few adjustable ones live.

What Pixiv-Patched changes

Ad blocker

Takes out the bottom banner on every screen and the AppLovin full-screen ads, stops the rate-this-app dialogs, and hides sponsored works in feeds and on artwork pages.

AI work flagger

Reads pixiv's own AI flag on each work, then dims the thumbnail with an [AI] badge or hides it. Artwork pages get a warning banner, and it can block AI artists or drop works whose tags are on your blacklist.

Downloader

Adds a save button on illustration and manga pages that writes the original image to Pictures/Pixiv, named after the work ID, title and author.

Search tweaks

Fills the Popular tab on a free account with pixiv's free popularity preview, hides results below a bookmark count you pick, and keeps a popular-search trial from running out.

History and novel copying

Keeps a browsing history of illustrations, manga and novels on the device. In the novel reader you can select text again and save a whole novel as a .txt file.

OLED black and instant zoom

Turns the dark theme pure black. The full-screen viewer shows the standard image straight away, so you can pinch-zoom while the original loads.

How to install

  1. Uninstall the Play Store version of pixiv. The signatures differ, so Android won't install over it. Your bookmarks and follows are stored on your pixiv account.
  2. Download the universal APK from the box above.
  3. Install it, allowing your browser or file manager to install unknown apps if Android asks.
  4. Log in, then open Pixiv-Patched from the side drawer if you'd rather hide AI works completely instead of dimming them.

pixiv FAQ

It's the pixiv app with patches from Piracola's open-source Pixiv-Patched bundle (GPL-3.0), built with Morphe CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It isn't from pixiv or the Morphe developers. Any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

No. The Premium Features patch fakes Premium status inside the app and removes the mute list limits, but your account is still free on pixiv's servers. That's why the Popular search tab shows pixiv's free popularity preview of about 30 works rather than the full ranking.

The Downloader patch saves the original file to Pictures/Pixiv, named after the work ID, title and author. On Android 9 and older it goes into the app's private folder instead.

Open the side drawer and tap Pixiv-Patched. That page has the AI work display options, the popular-search ranking and the bookmark threshold, plus your local browsing history. The other patches have no in-app switch.

apps.name: Morphe Podcast
apps.description: Podcast Addict with way-lo's community patches: swipe an episode to add it to or drop it from your playlist. No premium unlock, ads stay.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Podcast?

Despite the short name, this page is for Podcast Addict by Xavier Guillemane, one of the longest-running podcast players on Android. You subscribe to shows, it downloads new episodes in the background, and the player has the controls podcast fans care about: playback speed, skip silence, volume boost and a sleep timer.

The APK is built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with way-lo's waylo-patches, a small personal bundle that has nothing to do with official Morphe. It doesn't touch ads or premium. Its three Podcast Addict patches are all about building a playlist faster: swipe an episode sideways on the New episodes or Recent episodes screen to queue it, swipe it again to take it off, and swipe in the Playlist itself to remove one. If you were after an ad-free or premium build, this isn't it; the free app's ads are still there.

The swipe patches

Swipe on New episodes

Swipe an episode left or right to add it to the playlist. If it's already queued, the same swipe removes it.

Swipe on Recent episodes

The same add-or-remove gesture on the Recent episodes screen.

Swipe to remove from playlist

Clear out episodes from the Playlist with a swipe. Switching Playlist tabs by swiping stops working; tap the tab names instead.

Everything else is stock

Automatic downloads, speed, skip silence and the sleep timer are Podcast Addict's own, and so are the ads and the paid tier.

Moving to the patched Podcast Addict

  1. In your current Podcast Addict, export your subscriptions as OPML or make a backup from the settings. Uninstalling removes them along with your downloaded episodes.
  2. Remove the Play Store copy of Podcast Addict; Android won't install a differently signed APK on top of it.
  3. Download the APK from the box above (a single universal build) and allow installs from unknown sources.
  4. Install it, then import your OPML file or restore the backup.

Podcast Addict FAQ

It's the Podcast Addict app (package com.bambuna.podcastaddict). The short name comes from the build pipeline's app list.

No. way-lo's bundle only has three swipe-gesture patches for Podcast Addict. Ads and the paid features work exactly as in the free Play Store version.

The Swipe to remove from playlist patch takes over that gesture, and its own description warns about it. Tap the tab titles to switch tabs instead.

The community AutoBuilds pipeline, using way-lo's waylo-patches. way-lo says these are personal patches, not part of or endorsed by Morphe, and this site is unofficial and just links to the file. Install it only if you trust those sources.

You will if you uninstall the old app without exporting. Save an OPML export or a backup first, then import it after installing this build.

apps.name: Morphe Pokecardex
apps.description: Pokécardex APK with Almewty's community patches: card scans stop counting toward the cap and the free limit goes from 30 to 50. No root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Pokecardex?

Pokécardex is a collection manager for the Pokémon Trading Card Game. You point the camera at a card, it recognises it, and the card lands in your collection with its set and number. Free accounts only get a limited number of scans, which runs out fast if you're cataloguing a binder.

This build goes after exactly that limit. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched it with Morphe CLI and Almewty/my-morphe-patches, a small third-party bundle that is still a dev pre-release. It is not an official Morphe patch set, and the Pokécardex developers have nothing to do with it. The bundle has two patches, both switched on by default, and it doesn't touch anything else in the app.

What the two patches change

Scan counter frozen

Disable scan counter stops the app from bumping your scan count each time you scan a card.

Higher free limit

Increase scan limit moves the free allowance from 30 scans to 50, according to the patch description.

Everything else is stock

Collection lists and card details behave like the Play Store app. Nothing beyond the scan limit is unlocked.

32-bit ARM build only

The only APK is armeabi-v7a. It runs on most phones, but 64-bit-only devices can't install it.

Installing the Pokécardex APK

  1. If Pokécardex from Google Play is on your phone, uninstall it. This APK is signed with a different key, so Android won't update over the store version.
  2. Download the armeabi-v7a APK from the box above. There's no ARM64 or Universal file for this app.
  3. Open the file and let your browser or file manager install unknown apps when Android asks.
  4. Start Pokécardex and sign in again if you use an account.

Phones that dropped 32-bit app support, such as the Pixel 7 and later Pixels, will show a 'not compatible' error. There's nothing to fix on your side; the app just isn't built for them here.

Pokécardex questions

It's an unofficial build. The community AutoBuilds pipeline took the original Pokécardex APK, applied Almewty's open-source my-morphe-patches bundle with Morphe CLI and re-signed it. Neither the Pokécardex developers nor the Morphe team made it. Any modified APK carries some risk, so install it only if you trust the source.

No. The bundle only has the two scan patches: one stops the scan counter from going up and one raises the free limit from 30 to 50. Other paid features are left as they are.

Only a 32-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a) APK exists for this app. Most ARM64 phones still run 32-bit apps, but some recent ones, like the Pixel 7 and newer, only accept 64-bit apps and will refuse it.

Almewty's patches are written for one specific Pokécardex release. The build pipeline sticks to that release until the bundle supports a newer one.

apps.name: Morphe Prime Video
apps.description: Amazon Prime Video patched with semicoloncolonel's community patches: skips ad breaks and installs beside other Amazon apps. You still need Prime.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Prime Video?

Prime Video is Amazon's streaming app for films and series, including Amazon's own shows. In many countries the standard plan now plays ad breaks before and during titles unless you pay extra for the ad-free tier.

This build was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with semicoloncolonel's mobile-morphe-patches, a third-party bundle aimed at ads and tracking in streaming and shopping apps; it's not official Morphe. Two Prime Video patches are on by default and applied here. Skip ads skips every ad break, with one catch: titles play in the app's older player, so newer-player features such as X-Ray go missing. Rename shared permissions lets the patched app install next to Amazon Shopping and other Amazon apps. There's no playback speed patch in this bundle. A Prime or Prime Video membership is still required.

What changes in Prime Video

Skip ads

The bundle says it covers every ad break, so you shouldn't sit through any of them.

The older player

Skipping ads means using Prime Video's previous player. X-Ray and other things that only the new player has aren't there.

Rename shared permissions

Keeps the install from failing when Amazon Shopping or another Amazon app is already on the phone.

Membership still required

You sign in with your Amazon account, and what you can watch depends on your subscription.

Installing patched Prime Video

  1. Download the APK from the box above. Only a universal build is published.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store version of Prime Video. Android won't install a differently signed APK over it. Other Amazon apps can stay.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, then install.
  4. Sign in with your Amazon account. Downloads made in the old app won't carry over, so download them again.

Prime Video FAQ

The community AutoBuilds pipeline, using semicoloncolonel's open-source mobile-morphe-patches bundle. It isn't from the Morphe team or from Amazon, and this unofficial site only links to it. You'll be signing in with your Amazon account, so install it only if you trust those sources.

Yes. The bundle skips ads and nothing else on the content side. Its author says the patches don't remove paywalls or unlock paid content, so you only get what your account already includes.

To skip the ads, the patch makes titles play in Prime Video's older player. Features that only exist in the newer player, X-Ray among them, aren't available in this build.

Yes. Amazon apps share some permissions, and Android normally refuses to install a second app that declares them with a different signature. The Rename shared permissions patch is in this build so the patched Prime Video can sit next to Amazon Shopping and other Amazon apps.

Not in this build. The bundle has an experimental tracking blocker and a Disable AI patch for Prime Video, but both are off by default, and the automated build only applies the default patches.

apps.name: Morphe Prompter
apps.description: Teleprompter: Vlog & Scripts (Prompter Pal) APK with premium features unlocked by the Teleprompter Premium patch from community paresh-patches.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Prompter?

The app behind this page is Teleprompter: Vlog & Scripts by Solid Labs (the patch bundle lists it as Prompter Pal). It turns your phone into an autocue: your script scrolls next to the camera lens so you can read it while still looking into the camera. You can import scripts from PDF, TXT or Word, set the scroll speed, mirror the text for real teleprompter glass, or float the script over another camera app while you record.

This APK is patched with “Teleprompter Premium” from Paresh Maheshwari’s community paresh-patches bundle, which unlocks the app’s premium features. The patch doesn’t list which ones those are. It isn’t an official Morphe patch; the community AutoBuilds pipeline builds it.

What you get

Premium unlocked

The Teleprompter Premium patch switches on the paid tier inside the app.

Script overlay

The floating script that sits on top of other apps while you record is part of the app.

Mirror mode

Horizontal and vertical mirroring for use with physical teleprompter hardware.

Import your scripts

Load PDF, TXT or Word files instead of retyping them.

Built-in recording

Record straight from the app with the front or back camera, in portrait or landscape.

Which of these the free app limits changes over time, so this list is just what the app does, not a list of what the patch unlocks.

Install steps

  1. If you installed the teleprompter app from the Play Store, uninstall it. This build has a different signature. Copy any scripts you only kept inside the app somewhere else first.
  2. Download the Universal APK above and tap it to install, allowing unknown apps for your browser or file manager.
  3. Open the app and allow camera and microphone access. For the floating overlay, also allow it to display over other apps.

Teleprompter FAQ

It's Solid Labs' Teleprompter: Vlog & Scripts with Paresh Maheshwari's open-source Teleprompter Premium patch, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial, and modified APKs carry some risk. It also asks for camera and microphone access, so install it only if you trust the source.

Yes. It's the same package (com.solid.teleprompter). The patch bundle calls it Prompter Pal, and this site shortens it to Prompter.

The patch description just says premium features. We don't have a verified list, so if something still asks you to subscribe, it isn't covered.

Not from the Play Store. Install newer builds from this page over the old one.

apps.name: Morphe Proton Mail
apps.description: Proton Mail APK built with Morphe CLI and community patches. Encryption and plan limits still run on Proton's servers. Unofficial build, no root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Proton Mail?

Proton Mail is the end-to-end encrypted email service from Proton AG in Switzerland. Messages between Proton users are encrypted so that even Proton can't read them, and the app handles the keys for you. The free plan comes with limits on storage and addresses, and paid plans raise them.

The APK on this page was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Morphe CLI and a community patch bundle, not the official Morphe patches. We couldn't confirm which bundle: the pipeline switched Proton Mail between two different community sources around the time this file was built, and neither record ties to this exact APK. So we won't list features. One thing is certain. Storage, extra addresses and other paid-plan limits are enforced by Proton's servers, so no patch can raise them.

Before you install

Your Proton account

You sign in with your normal Proton account. Mail, folders and contacts come from Proton's servers.

Patches not identified

The exact community bundle behind this APK couldn't be confirmed, so its changes aren't listed here.

Plan limits are server-side

Storage quota, custom domains and extra addresses are controlled by Proton and stay tied to your plan.

Higher stakes than usual

This app holds access to your encrypted mailbox. A modified build is a bigger trust decision than, say, a game.

Installing Proton Mail

  1. Uninstall the Play Store Proton Mail first. Your mail stays on Proton's servers, but the signature is different, so Android won't install over it.
  2. Download the Universal APK above.
  3. Allow installs from unknown sources for your browser when asked, then install.
  4. Sign in. If you use two-factor authentication, have your code ready.

Proton Mail FAQ

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original Proton Mail APK with Morphe CLI and a community patch bundle, then re-signed it. Proton and the Morphe team didn't make it. For an encrypted email account the risk of a modified app is higher than usual, and the official app is free, so install this only if you fully trust the source.

No. Storage, addresses and other plan limits are enforced by Proton's servers. A patched app can't change them.

Encryption happens in the app with your keys, the same way as in the official build, but you're trusting whoever built this APK not to have changed that. That's why you should only use it if you trust the source.

apps.name: Morphe Proton VPN
apps.description: Proton VPN patched with hxreborn's community bundle: pick free servers, NetShield, split tunneling, custom DNS, no switch delay, telemetry off.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Proton VPN?

Proton VPN is the VPN from Proton AG, the Swiss company behind Proton Mail. Its free plan has no data cap, which is rare, but it picks the server for you, makes you wait before switching, and keeps split tunneling, custom DNS, NetShield and profiles for the paid Proton VPN Plus plan.

This APK was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hxreborn/morphe-patches, a large third-party bundle by hxreborn, not the official Morphe one. It has 14 patches for the Play Store Proton VPN and all of them are on by default. Most open up paid settings on the free plan or let you pick a free location yourself. The rest hide the upgrade banners and offers, turn off telemetry, and change the look: a pure black dark theme, a custom accent colour, an optional floating navigation bar and Material 3 style switches. Plus servers stay off limits, because your account controls those.

What the patches change

Pick a free location

Free server countries show up in Countries and Search, and the app connects to the one you choose instead of picking for you.

No wait between servers

Remove server change delay takes out the wait the free plan puts between server changes.

NetShield

Proton's built-in ad and tracker blocker, normally a Plus feature, works on the free plan.

Split tunneling, custom DNS, LAN

Send only some apps through the VPN, use your own DNS server, and keep reaching the printer or NAS on your home network.

Profiles and connection preferences

Set a default connection, use recent connections and excluded locations, and build profiles. Profiles only cover free locations.

Quieter app

Upgrade banners, the VPN Plus carousel and special offers are hidden, and usage statistics and diagnostics no longer go to Proton.

How to install it

  1. Download the APK from the box above. It's a single universal build.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store Proton VPN. The patched copy has a different signature and won't install over it.
  3. Allow installs from unknown sources for your browser or file manager, then install the APK.
  4. Sign in with your Proton account, and accept Android's VPN connection prompt the first time you connect.

Proton VPN FAQ

Think about this one carefully. A VPN app sees all of your traffic. This build comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hxreborn's open-source morphe-patches, a third-party bundle, not from Proton or the Morphe team, and this unofficial site only links to it. Install it only if you trust those sources.

No. Your account decides which servers you can reach. The patches let you choose among the free locations and use the paid settings on them, and profiles are limited to free locations too.

Yes. The Show free server locations patch lists the free countries in Countries and Search, and connecting goes to the one you tap. On top of that, Remove server change delay takes out the wait between switches.

NetShield, Proton's own ad and tracker blocking, is unlocked on the free plan by the Unlock NetShield patch. Separately, Disable telemetry stops the app sending usage statistics and diagnostics to Proton.

No. It's a normal APK and uses Android's built-in VPN system.

apps.name: Morphe Pydroid
apps.description: Pydroid 3, the offline Python IDE for Android, with hxreborn's community patches: premium unlocked, ads gone, Firebase Analytics off, AMOLED editor theme.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Pydroid?

Pydroid 3 is a Python 3 IDE that runs entirely on your phone, so you can run scripts with no internet connection. It comes with pip and its own repository of prebuilt packages, which matters for libraries like NumPy, Matplotlib or scikit-learn that are a pain to compile on Android. There's also Tkinter support, a terminal, and a built-in C/C++ compiler for packages with native code. The free version shows ads and keeps some features for premium.

This APK was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hxreborn/morphe-patches, a third-party bundle, not the official Morphe one. It has three Pydroid 3 patches, all on by default. Unlock premium turns on premium and removes the ads, Disable tracking stops Firebase Analytics from collecting usage data, and AMOLED dark theme adds a pure black editor theme. The patch descriptions don't list the individual premium features, so this page doesn't either.

What you get

Unlock premium

Switches the app to its premium state and removes the ads the free version shows.

Disable tracking

Firebase Analytics stops collecting data about how you use the app.

AMOLED editor theme

A black option under Settings > Appearance > Editor theme (dark). It only shows while the Dark theme is active.

Offline Python 3

The interpreter is on the device, so scripts run without a connection.

pip with prebuilt packages

What is Morphe RAR?

RAR is the Android version of WinRAR, made by RARLAB. It creates RAR and ZIP archives and opens most of the other formats you're likely to run into, and it doubles as a basic file manager. The free version shows ads unless you pay for the no-ads subscription.

This APK was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline using Morphe CLI and the third-party rushiranpise/morphe-patches bundle (not the official Morphe patches). The bundle has one patch for RAR, Unlock Pro, applied by default. It removes the ads and unlocks the no-ads subscription, and that's all it does.

Morphe RAR Features

Ads removed

The Unlock Pro patch strips out the ads you'd normally see in the free version.

No-ads subscription unlocked

The app treats the no-ads subscription as active, so it doesn't keep asking you to buy it.

Archiving untouched

Compression and extraction are RARLAB's own code. The bundle doesn't list any patch that touches them.

Small download

RAR is a light app and this is a single Universal APK, so it's quick to grab even on mobile data.

How to Install Morphe RAR

  1. Uninstall the Play Store version of RAR first. This build is signed with a different key and won't install over it.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps (Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps).
  4. Install it, open RAR and grant storage access when it asks, the same as the store version.

Morphe RAR FAQ

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original RAR APK with Morphe CLI and rushiranpise's open-source morphe-patches bundle, then re-signed it. RARLAB and the Morphe team didn't build it. A modified APK always carries some risk, so install it only if you trust the source.

apps.name: Morphe Reddit
apps.description: Morphe Reddit APK with the official Morphe patches: promoted posts hidden, links open directly, guest start and fewer popups. Replaces the Play Store app.

What is Morphe Reddit?

This is the app Reddit publishes itself, with the official Morphe patches applied. If you miss the third-party clients that shut down after Reddit's API changes, it's about as close as you can get to a cleaner Reddit while still using the official app. The APK is put together by the community AutoBuilds pipeline; this site just points you to it.

Reddit's patch list is much shorter than YouTube's and sticks to practical things. Promoted posts are gone, the Trending and suggested-community shelves can be hidden, outbound links skip Reddit's redirect and can open in your own browser, and a few nagging dialogs get dismissed for you. It doesn't unlock Reddit Premium or anything tied to your account.

What Morphe changes in Reddit

Promoted posts hidden

The Hide ads patch takes ads out of the feed and comment threads.

Links go straight to the site

Skip Reddit's redirect URLs, open links in your normal browser instead of the in-app one, and strip tracking parameters from links you share.

Fewer shelves in the feed

Hide the Trending shelves in the feed and in search suggestions, the related-communities shelf in subreddits, and the Ask button in the search bar.

Start as guest

Skips the login screen that Reddit forces on startup by using its own guest browsing mode, so you can read without an account.

Fewer popups

No popup every time you take a screenshot. The NSFW community warning and the notification suggestion dialog are dismissed automatically.

Your font, not Reddit Sans

Render the app in your phone's system font, or load any TTF or OTF file you have.

View counts on posts

Shows how many times a post has been viewed, a number the stock app keeps hidden.

Trimmed navigation

Hide buttons in the bottom navigation bar and items in the sidebar, and pick from the alternative Reddit app icons.

How to install Morphe Reddit

  1. Uninstall the Play Store Reddit first. This build keeps Reddit's normal package name but has a different signature, so Android won't put it on top of the original. Your subscriptions and saved posts are stored on Reddit's servers, so all you lose is the login.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above.
  3. Open it, allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps if asked, and tap Install.
  4. Sign in, or just browse as a guest. Then go through Reddit's settings to find the options the patches add.

Morphe Reddit FAQ

It's Reddit's own APK with the open-source MorpheApp/morphe-patches bundle applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline rather than this site or the Morphe developers. The patches are public, but modified APKs always carry some risk. Install it only if you trust the source.

apps.name: Morphe Smart Launcher
apps.description: Smart Launcher with heval99's community patches: Pro features on, promo banners and rating prompts hidden, analytics off. One universal APK, no root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Smart Launcher?

Smart Launcher replaces your phone's home screen. Its party trick is the app drawer: it sorts everything you install into categories on its own, so you rarely scroll through one long alphabetical list. You also get its own widgets, gesture shortcuts and a theme that picks up colours from your wallpaper. Some of the customisation options are reserved for the Pro upgrade, and the free app likes to show promo banners and ask for ratings.

This APK is built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches, a community bundle maintained by heval99, not the official Morphe patch set. The bundle has five Smart Launcher patches and all of them are on by default: Enable Premium for the Pro features, Hide promotions, Disable telemetry, a widget fix for Samsung phones, and Spoof signature, which keeps the re-signed app from refusing to start. Neither Smart Launcher Team nor the Morphe developers are involved.

What this Smart Launcher build changes

Enable Premium

Unlocks the Pro features, as far as the app checks that on the phone. The patch doesn't list them one by one.

Hide promotions

No promo banners, no "rate us" prompts and no surveys popping up while you set up your home screen.

Disable telemetry

Turns off the launcher's analytics and crash reporting.

Galaxy Buds3 Pro widget fix

On Samsung phones with One UI 8.5, the Buds3 Pro widget can be configured again and its layout follows the widget's size.

Spoof signature

A behind-the-scenes patch so the launcher starts normally after being re-signed.

Same launcher underneath

The auto-sorted drawer, home pages, widgets and gestures are Smart Launcher's own. There's one universal APK, so no architecture to pick.

Installing it as your home screen

  1. If you already use Smart Launcher from the Play Store, save a backup of your layout first. You'll have to uninstall that copy, and your home screen setup goes with it.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store version. This build is signed with a different key, so Android won't install it on top.
  3. Download the APK from the box above and let your browser or file manager install unknown apps when Android asks.
  4. Install it, press the Home button and choose Smart Launcher as your default home app.

Smart Launcher questions

It's the Smart Launcher APK with five patches from heval99's open-source Heval-Morphe-Patches bundle, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It isn't an official release from Smart Launcher Team or from Morphe, and any modified APK carries some risk, especially a launcher that sees every app you open. Install it only if you trust that source.

What is Morphe Snorelab?

SnoreLab, made by Reviva Softworks, is the app you leave running on the bedside table overnight. It listens while you sleep, picks out the snoring, and in the morning gives you a score and clips you can play back. You can tag nights with things like alcohol, a blocked nose or a new remedy and see whether the numbers change. A chunk of the app is part of its premium subscription.

The build here adds a single patch, Enable Premium, from hyzor/hyzor-morphe-patches, a third-party bundle by hyzor. It makes the app treat you as premium locally, so the features SnoreLab keeps behind its subscription open up on your phone. The APK comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline using the Morphe CLI; it's not an official Morphe build and Reviva has nothing to do with it.

What you get in this build

Enable Premium

The only SnoreLab patch in hyzor's bundle, on by default. It flips the app's own premium check, not your account.

Overnight recording as normal

Recording, snore detection and the morning report work the way they do in the Play Store app. Nothing about the measuring is changed.

Remedies and factors

Logging what you tried each night is the app's standard feature, and that stays the same here.

Universal APK

One file that installs on any reasonably recent Android phone. No root needed.

apps.name: Morphe Sofascore
apps.description: Sofascore APK built with heval99's community patches: no ads, Premium unlocked on the app side, a spoiler-free mode and less tracking.

What is Morphe Sofascore?

Sofascore is a live score app for football and a long list of other sports: tennis, basketball, ice hockey, cricket and more. apps.name: Morphe Solid Explorer

What is Morphe Solid Explorer?

Solid Explorer by NeatBytes is a file manager with two panes side by side, which makes moving files between folders a lot less fiddly than on most Android file apps. It opens ZIP and other archives, and it can connect to FTP, SFTP and SMB shares as well as cloud storage. After the trial period runs out, the app wants you to buy the full version.

Here you get Solid Explorer with the Enable Pro patch from hoo-dles/morphe-patches, a community bundle maintained by hoo-dles. It targets the paywall that normally appears once the trial is over. What's different in this build

Enable Pro

The bundle's only Solid Explorer patch. It removes the purchase lock the app puts on its features.

Two panes, unchanged

Dual-pane browsing, archives and the file operations themselves are exactly what NeatBytes ships.

Network and cloud

Remote connections are set up the same way as in the official app. If you switch over, you'll need to add them again.

Universal APK

There's a single APK for all architectures, so just download it.

apps.name: Morphe SoundCloud
apps.description: SoundCloud APK built with 2kshoka's community patches: no ads, client-side Go with standard-quality offline caching, AMOLED theme and a sleep timer.

What is Morphe SoundCloud?

SoundCloud is where a lot of music turns up before it reaches anywhere else: DJ mixes, remixes, bedroom producers, unofficial edits, plus podcasts and big-label releases. The free tier plays audio ads between tracks, pushes Go upgrade prompts at you and keeps offline listening for paying users.

Patches in this SoundCloud build

Remove ads and upsells

The app stops requesting audio and display ads, and the Go upgrade prompts are hidden.

Enable SoundCloud Go

Shows the Go+ badge and lets you save tracks and playlists offline in standard quality. High-quality streams and downloads stay locked on SoundCloud's side.

AMOLED dark theme

Dark mode goes true black, bottom bar and mini-player included, while the orange accents stay.

Sleep timer in the track menu

Pick a time on a round dial or a saved preset and playback stops on its own. You can extend or cancel it with one tap.

Home in Android Auto

The car's Home tab shows the cover tiles from your phone's Home feed, and Up next lists the real queue.

Analytics and consent popup

SoundCloud's own event tracking is blocked and the cookie consent popup is skipped. Other tracking SDKs in the app keep running.

Enable Features patch

Planetarium and object list

apps.name: Morphe Tasker

Tasker is João Dias's automation app. You build profiles from triggers like time, location, Wi-Fi or an incoming notification, and Tasker runs tasks in response: toggling settings, sending messages, launching apps, calling plugins. It's sold on Google Play, and the trial version stops working with a dialog you can't dismiss once the trial period is over.

This build removes that wall. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched it with ReVanced CLI and indrastorms/Dropped-Patches, a bundle that picked up patches other projects had dropped. It's not part of Morphe. Its Tasker patch, Unlock trial, makes the license check method return before it does anything, so the trial-over dialog never appears. Everything else is the normal Tasker.

What changes in this Tasker build

Trial doesn't run out

Unlock trial skips the license check that would otherwise show the trial-expired dialog.

Full Tasker otherwise

Profiles, tasks, scenes and variables are untouched. It's the same automation engine.

Plugins are separate

AutoApps and other plugins have their own licences, and this patch doesn't cover them.

Built with ReVanced CLI

A community ReVanced-format patch applied by the AutoBuilds pipeline, not a Morphe build.

Installing Tasker

  1. Export a backup of your profiles and tasks from your current Tasker first, then uninstall it. The signatures don't match, so Android won't install this APK over the Play Store version.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above.
  3. Allow your browser to install unknown apps and install the file.
  4. Open Tasker, import your backup and grant the permissions your profiles need again.

Some Tasker actions need extra permissions granted over ADB. If you set those up before, you'll have to grant them again for the reinstalled app.

Tasker FAQ

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original Tasker APK with ReVanced CLI and indrastorms' open-source Dropped-Patches bundle and re-signed it. João Dias and the Morphe team didn't make it. Tasker can be given very broad permissions, so modified builds carry real risk. Install it only if you trust the source.

Not automatically, because you have to uninstall the Play Store version first. Back up your data in Tasker before uninstalling, then import it into the new install.

Tasker comes from a small independent developer and is a one-time purchase on Google Play. If you use it every day, buying it supports updates and gets you a build that updates from the Play Store.

apps.name: Morphe Telegram
apps.description: Telegram APK built with rahul9999xda's community patches: anti-delete, no sponsored messages, hidden typing, faster downloads and local Premium.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Telegram?

Telegram needs little introduction: a cloud-based messenger with chats, big groups, channels and file sharing, where your message history lives on Telegram’s servers and syncs across every device you log in on.

The APK linked here comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline, which runs rahul9999xda’s morphe-patches bundle through the Morphe CLI. These are community patches, not official Morphe ones, and not from Telegram. The bundle’s Telegram patches are written for the regular org.telegram.messenger package and list the same Telegram release this build uses. Everything below comes from the patches the bundle switches on by default.

What the Telegram patch set does

Anti-delete

When someone deletes a message, your copy stays. Secret media is kept in local storage after you view it. Deleting your own messages works as normal.

No sponsored messages

Removes the sponsored messages in channels and the video ads.

Quieter presence

No “typing…” while you write, no read receipts when you watch Stories, and the other person isn’t told when you take a screenshot.

Fewer channel restrictions

Opens channels flagged as restricted, sensitive or blocked for copyright, and lets you save and forward from chats that turn that off.

Faster downloads

Large files come down in 1 MB chunks with up to 12 requests at once.

Premium, on the app side

The Unlock Premium patch opens the Premium checks made inside the app. Anything Telegram enforces on its servers, like larger upload limits, can’t be unlocked that way.

Also on by default: voice messages play through Telegram’s music player (raise-to-listen still works), the update notice is switched off, and a Morphe Settings screen is added to the app. The bundle’s telemetry patch is off by default, so this build doesn’t include it.

How to install

  1. Uninstall the Play Store Telegram first. This build uses the same package name with a different signature, so Android won’t install it on top.
  2. Before uninstalling, keep in mind that secret chats only exist on the device and are lost. Normal cloud chats come back after you log in.
  3. Download the Universal APK from the box above and open it, allowing installs from your browser or file manager.
  4. Log in with your phone number and the code Telegram sends you, then re-enable notifications in Android settings if needed.

Telegram FAQ

It's Telegram rebuilt by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with rahul9999xda's open-source morphe-patches bundle. It's unofficial and not from Telegram. A messenger has access to all your conversations, so be careful with modified versions and install it only if you trust the source.

That's what the Bypass integrity check patch is for. Telegram checks the app's certificate and SafetyNet at login, and a re-signed APK would fail that, so the patch spoofs both. You log in with your phone number and the code Telegram sends, as usual.

Cloud chats, groups and channels sync back as soon as you log in. Secret chats are stored only on the old install and won't come back.

Only the parts the app checks on the phone. Things Telegram checks on its servers, such as the bigger upload limit, still need a real subscription.

Download the newer APK from this page and install it over the old one. The in-app update notice is switched off and the Play Store won't update it.

apps.name: Morphe Teuida
apps.description: Teuida APK with the experimental local Premium patch from MangoTornado's suchi bundle. Unofficial; server-side content and stability aren't guaranteed.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Teuida?

Teuida is a language app built around speaking, best known for its Korean course. Instead of tapping through flashcards, you're dropped into staged situations, like ordering in a café or meeting someone new, and you answer the person on screen out loud. A lot of the course sits behind a Premium subscription.

The builds here used to list hoo-dles' bundle, which had no Teuida patches left. They now come from MangoTornado's morphe-patches-suchi, a small personal bundle with two experimental Teuida patches, both marked as research and off by default. The AutoBuilds config turns on one of them, Enable local Premium controls, and leaves the MicroG one out. The pipeline applies it with the Morphe CLI. This isn't an official Morphe or Teuida release.

What this Teuida build changes

Local Premium checks

The app's own Premium getters always answer yes, so screens that would show a Premium prompt treat you as a subscriber.

Server content unconfirmed

The patch doesn't touch your account. Whether Teuida's servers hand over Premium lessons and story videos hasn't been tested by the author.

May crash on start

Teuida has app protection that the bundle doesn't handle yet. In the author's offline tests, re-signed APKs crashed at startup.

No MicroG patch

The experimental MicroG integration is left out, so expect Google sign-in to fail on this build.

Installing it anyway

  1. Check your Android version. The bundle's research notes give Android 12L as the minimum for the Teuida release it targets.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store version first if you have it. The signature is different, so the two clash.
  3. Download the APK above and allow installs from your browser or file manager.
  4. Install it and sign in with a non-Google login. Your course progress is tied to your Teuida account, not to this APK.

Teuida FAQ

It's Teuida patched with MangoTornado's open-source morphe-patches-suchi bundle and built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial and re-signed. The bundle's own research notes also say the patch changes the user type Teuida reports to its analytics SDK. Only install it if you're comfortable with that.

It makes the app's own Premium checks return yes, so the Premium prompts inside the app should step aside. Whether the lessons and story videos behind them actually load depends on Teuida's servers, and the patch author hasn't confirmed that. Your account isn't upgraded.

It might not. The bundle's README says re-signed Teuida APKs crashed during its offline startup tests, and support for the app's protection is still pending. If it crashes, go back to the Play Store version.

Probably not. The bundle's MicroG integration patch is experimental and the AutoBuilds config leaves it out, so Google sign-in on this re-signed APK is likely to fail. Use another login method if your account has one.

apps.name: Morphe Threads

What is Morphe Threads?

Threads is Meta's text-first social app, linked to your Instagram account. The patch set here is small. durgesh0505/chiggi_morphe_patches is a community bundle that covers a mix of apps and has four patches for Threads, and this build uses all of them. It's not an official Morphe bundle, and the APK is built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline.

It's mostly about ads. Sponsored posts and the suggested units Meta mixes into the feed are hidden, and the advertising ID permission is removed so the app can't read your device's ad ID. The author is clear that the ad blocking happens in the app only and that Meta's core analytics keep running. The other two patches rename the package and the app label so it can sit next to the regular Threads.

The four Threads patches

Sponsored posts hidden

Sponsored posts and injected suggested units are dropped from the feed. It's done on your phone, so Meta still serves the ads; you just don't see them.

No advertising ID

Removes the AD_ID permission so Threads can't read your device's advertising ID for ad tracking. Other analytics are unaffected.

Runs beside the official app

A different package name means you can keep the Play Store Threads installed and use both.

Its own name on the home screen

The app label is changed so you can tell the patched copy from the original in your launcher.

Installing Morphe Threads

  1. Download the Universal APK from the box above.
  2. Install it, allowing unknown apps for your browser or file manager when asked. There's no need to remove the official Threads, since this one has its own package name.
  3. Log in. If one-tap login through Instagram or Facebook doesn't work, use your username and password instead.

The package rename has known side effects. The patch author warns that Meta apps hardcode a lot of internal references, so single sign-on, content sharing between Meta apps or push notifications may not work properly.

Morphe Threads questions

It's the Threads APK with durgesh0505's open-source chiggi_morphe_patches bundle applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline and not by this site or the Morphe developers. There's always some risk with a modified app, so only install it if you trust the source.

The build renames the package so it can live next to the official app. Meta's apps expect the original name, and the patch author warns this can break Facebook and Instagram single sign-on, content providers and push notifications. Logging in with your password usually gets around it.

Not really. It removes the advertising ID permission and hides ads in the feed, but Meta's own analytics still run.

No. Because of the different package name you can keep both.

Threads doesn't get much attention from patch developers yet. This bundle has four Threads patches and the build includes all four. There's no download, theming or feed filtering patch for Threads in it.

apps.name: Morphe Ticktick
apps.description: TickTick APK with Premium, AI tools and working reminders, built from three patches in Paresh Maheshwari's community paresh-patches bundle.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe TickTick?

TickTick from TickTick Limited is a to-do list and calendar in one app, with habits and a Pomodoro timer thrown in, and it syncs your tasks across phone, web and desktop. The free plan works but sets limits on things like lists and tasks, and saves things like the full calendar views and the AI tools for Premium.

This build combines three patches from Paresh Maheshwari’s community paresh-patches bundle. “TickTick Premium” unlocks the premium features, removes the limits and enables the AI tools. The other two exist because re-signing an APK normally breaks things: one fixes push notifications, the other brings back reminder alarms. These aren’t official Morphe patches; the community AutoBuilds pipeline applies them.

What’s patched

Premium in the app

Premium features and the free-plan limits are lifted on this phone.

AI tools

The patch enables TickTick’s AI tools. They run on TickTick’s servers, so they may still refuse to work for a free account.

Notifications that arrive

The Restore notifications patch spoofs the original signing certificate so Firebase push messages still reach the app.

Reminder alarms

Restore reminder alarms fixes alarm scheduling, which otherwise breaks on a re-signed TickTick.

Switching to this build

  1. Make sure your tasks are synced to your TickTick account, then uninstall the Play Store version. The signatures don’t match.
  2. Download the Universal APK above and open it. Allow installs from your browser or file manager if Android asks.
  3. Sign in. If you use Google sign-in and it fails, try email and password instead. We haven’t verified Google sign-in on this build.
  4. Allow notifications and, on newer Android versions, the alarms and reminders permission, then set a test reminder a few minutes out.

TickTick FAQ

It's TickTick with three patches from Paresh Maheshwari's open-source paresh-patches bundle, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial and not from TickTick Limited. You sign in with your real account, so install it only if you trust the source.

That's what two of the three patches are for. Restore notifications keeps push messages working after re-signing and Restore reminder alarms fixes alarm scheduling. Set a test reminder after installing to be sure.

No. The patch changes this Android app only. Your account stays on the free plan on TickTick's servers, so other devices and anything checked server-side are unchanged.

apps.name: Morphe TikTok
apps.description: TikTok APK with icysymmetra's community Morphe patches: watermark-free downloads, a feed filter for ads and Shop, playback speed and region spoof.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe TikTok?

TikTok is ByteDance's short-video app. This build is the global TikTok with icysymmetra/tiktok-patches-for-morphe applied; inside the app the patches show up as a Metra patches settings menu. It's a community bundle, not part of the official Morphe patches, and the APK comes out of the community AutoBuilds pipeline.

Downloads are the main reason to use it: no watermark, a choice of quality, your own folder and filename format. Close behind is the feed filter, which can hide ads, TikTok Shop items, lives, stories and photo posts, or anything outside a view or like range you set. Be ready for a big download, since it's one Universal APK that carries the native code for every phone type.

What's patched in Morphe TikTok

Watermark-free downloads

Save videos without the TikTok watermark, pick the quality, choose the folder and filename template, and save comment stickers.

Feed filter

Hide ads, Shop items, lives, stories and photo posts, plus videos outside a view or like range. There's also a filter for some of the unpersonalized filler on For You and for posts labelled as AI-made.

Playback controls

Playback speed for every video, remembered between videos. Show the seekbar with preview thumbnails, stop videos from looping, and lock 2x with a hold-and-slide.

Region spoof

In-app controls to change the region TikTok reads from your device.

Login fixes

Google sign-in works again after patching, and the mandatory login gate is removed from the flows that support it.

Better comments

Full comment sorting, built-in comment translation, copy a comment without the username, and the publish date always shown on videos.

Less clutter

Hide the LIVE, follow, save and search buttons on the feed, the floating coin and promo badges, suggested accounts and the Tako AI bubble.

Screenshots allowed

Screenshot blocking and capture detection are turned off, Circle to Search included. Links open in your browser and shared links lose their tracking.

How to install Morphe TikTok

  1. If you have TikTok from the Play Store, uninstall it first. This build doesn't rename the package, so Android won't install it over a differently signed copy.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above. It's a very large file, so use Wi-Fi and make sure you have the space.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, then install the APK.
  4. Sign in (Google login is fixed by one of the patches) and open the Metra patches settings to set up downloads and filters.

Common questions about Morphe TikTok

It's the TikTok APK with icysymmetra's open-source community patches applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline, not by this site and not by the Morphe developers. Modified apps carry some risk and TikTok doesn't permit them, so only install it if you trust the source.

Come back to this page and install the newer APK over the old one. If Android refuses because the signature changed, uninstall first; your account comes back after you sign in, but local drafts are lost.

Inside this Trakt build

No VIP banner

Stock Trakt otherwise

History, watchlist, check-ins and recommendations work exactly as in the Play Store version.

VIP stays VIP

Your account, unchanged

You sign in with your normal Trakt account, and everything syncs to it.

apps.name: Morphe Truecaller
apps.description: Truecaller APK built with heval99's community patches: no ads or promos, Premium on the app side, no contact upload and far fewer nag prompts.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Truecaller?

Truecaller is the caller ID and spam blocker from Truecaller AB. It looks up unknown numbers as they ring, warns you about spam and scam calls, and can take over as your phone and SMS app. The free version comes with ads, a steady stream of prompts to make it your default dialer or fill in your profile, and it uploads your contacts to Truecaller's servers.

This build is patched with heval99’s community bundle Heval-Morphe-Patches, applied by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with the Morphe CLI. Its default Truecaller patches remove ads and promotions, unlock Premium on the app side, stop the contact upload, switch off telemetry and silence most of the nag prompts. They also route Google services through MicroG RE. These are community patches, not official Morphe ones.

What the patches change

Enable Premium

Premium features the app checks locally are unlocked. Server features such as Who viewed me stay locked.

No ads or promo cards

Ads are removed, along with promo banners, referral offers, invite cards and the Who viewed me teasers.

Your contacts stay put

The contact upload is stopped, the Privacy Center sharing options start off unless you opt in, and analytics and crash reporting are disabled.

Far fewer prompts

No reminders to set Truecaller as the default dialer, grant permissions or finish your profile, no “Did we show the right name?” surveys, and no update prompts.

No auto-launch

Truecaller no longer opens itself in the background.

Google services via MicroG RE

GmsCore support and a signature spoof keep Google sign-in and Drive backup working on the re-signed APK, as long as MicroG RE is installed.

The bundle also adds a Patch settings screen and hides the Wear OS entry in settings. Its patches for hiding the Assistant, Scams, Premium and Messages tabs or the Family Protection button are off by default, so the bottom bar looks like the normal app.

Installing Truecaller

  1. Install MicroG RE first if you want Google sign-in or Drive backup.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store Truecaller so the two don’t clash; the signatures are different.
  3. Download the Universal APK above, open it and allow installs from your browser or file manager.
  4. Verify your number. The bundle’s patch that reads the code from SMS isn’t applied in this build, and its own note warns that verification can fail on patched apps.
  5. Set Truecaller as your caller ID and spam app, or as your default phone app, if you want it to identify calls.

Truecaller FAQ

It's Truecaller patched with heval99's open-source Heval-Morphe-Patches bundle and built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial, and the bundle's README says its patches are written with AI assistance before being tested. Truecaller can read your contacts, call log and messages, so think carefully before installing a modified copy and only do it if you trust the source.

For Google features, yes. The build includes the GmsCore support patch, which sends Google sign-in and other Google services through MicroG RE. Google Drive backup in particular needs it.

No. Enable Premium unlocks what the app checks locally, and the patch's own note says server features like Who viewed me stay locked.

Because this build stops Truecaller from uploading your contact list. Chat uses that upload to work out which of your contacts are on Truecaller, so it can't match them any more.

apps.name: Morphe TTMIK Stories

What is Morphe TTMIK Stories?

TTMIK Stories is from Talk To Me In Korean, the team behind the well-known Korean lessons and podcasts. It's a reader for graded Korean stories: you pick stories that match your level and read them with audio. The free tier gives you a sample, and the full library needs a subscription.

It has a single TTMIK Stories patch, Enable Premium, which is on by default and enables the features the app keeps behind its paywall. The patch is tied to one exact app version, so this APK won't always match what's on Google Play.

What this build changes

Enable Premium

Turns on the app's subscription-only features, according to the patch description.

Stories and audio as usual

The stories and audio are TTMIK's own content. The patch doesn't alter them.

Pinned to one version

The patch needs a specific TTMIK Stories release, so updates arrive only when hoo-dles updates the bundle.

Online content may still check

If a story or feature is unlocked on TTMIK's servers rather than in the app, a subscription may still be needed.

Installing TTMIK Stories

  1. Uninstall the Play Store version of TTMIK Stories first. Its signature is different, and Android blocks the patched APK until it's gone.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above. It's the only build.
  3. Let your browser install unknown apps, then open the file and install it.
  4. Start the app and choose your level.

TTMIK Stories FAQ

It's an unofficial build. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original APK with Morphe CLI and hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches bundle and re-signed it. Talk To Me In Korean and the Morphe team didn't make it. Modified APKs carry risk, so install it only if you trust the source.

apps.name: Morphe Tumblr
apps.description: Tumblr APK with hoomans' community patches: no dashboard ads or Blaze posts, no Tumblr TV tab, fewer popups. Morphe CLI build, no root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Tumblr?

Tumblr is the blogging and reblogging network run by Automattic. It's where fandoms, artists and meme accounts post, and where your dashboard fills up with whatever the people you follow reblog. These days it also fills up with ads, promoted Blaze posts and the odd popup asking you to buy something.

The APK here was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Morphe CLI and arandomhooman/hoomans-morphe-patches, a third-party bundle and not the official Morphe patches. It has eight Tumblr patches, all on by default. Most of them remove clutter. One, Enable premium UI, is purely cosmetic: it shows the Premium badge and settings entry on your phone but doesn't give you anything Tumblr's servers check for.

Patched in this Tumblr build

Ads and Blaze posts removed

Remove ads drops ad-network ads from the dashboard and the paid Blaze posts people inject into your feed. Your following feed and reblogs are untouched.

No Tumblr TV tab

Disable Tumblr TV takes the Tumblr TV tab out of the bottom navigation bar.

No frog banner

Fewer nags

Separate patches stop the blog notification reminder, the TumblrMart gift popup and the share sheet that appears when you take a screenshot.

No update prompt

Premium look only

Installing patched Tumblr

Tumblr FAQ

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original Tumblr APK with Morphe CLI and arandomhooman's open-source hoomans-morphe-patches bundle and re-signed it. Tumblr and the Morphe team didn't make it. Modified APKs carry risk and this one has access to your Tumblr account, so install it only if you trust the source.

Ventusky, from the Czech company InMeteo, puts the weather on a moving map of the whole planet. Ventusky build details

Enable Premium

The same weather layers

Server-side limits remain

Universal APK

There's just one file, and it works on any architecture.

How to install Ventusky

Ventusky FAQ

What is Morphe VN Video Editor?

VN (VN: Photo & Video Editor, from Ubiquiti Labs) is a popular choice when you want a proper timeline on your phone: multiple tracks, trimming and splitting, text, music, transitions and speed changes. The free version is generous, but some effects and tools are Pro-only and a Pro tab keeps reminding you about it.

This build applies “VN Premium” from Paresh Maheshwari’s community paresh-patches bundle. The patch says it unlocks premium features, removes the watermark and hides the Pro tab. It’s not an official Morphe patch; the community AutoBuilds pipeline builds the APK.

What VN Premium changes

No watermark

Exports come out clean, without VN’s watermark in the corner.

Premium features

The Pro-only tools and effects are unlocked, according to the patch. It doesn’t list them one by one.

Pro tab hidden

The upsell tab is removed from the navigation.

Same editor

The multi-track timeline and editing tools are the original app’s. The patch doesn’t change them.

Installing VN

  1. Export any finished videos from your current VN, and keep in mind that drafts stored inside the app are lost when you uninstall it.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store VN. This build is signed differently.
  3. Download the Universal APK from the box above and open it, allowing installs from your browser or file manager.
  4. Open VN and give it access to your photos and videos so you can add clips to a project.

VN FAQ

It's Ubiquiti Labs' VN with Paresh Maheshwari's open-source VN Premium patch, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial and not supported by VN. Modified APKs carry some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

About this Wallcraft build

Enable Premium

Same catalogue

apps.name: Morphe Webster
apps.description: Merriam-Webster Dictionary APK with an Add to Anki button that turns any definition into an AnkiDroid flashcard. Community build, universal APK.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Webster?

"Webster" here means the Merriam-Webster Dictionary app, the Android version of the long-running American dictionary. You look up a word and get definitions, example sentences, synonyms and an audio pronunciation, and there's a Word of the Day if you like picking up new vocabulary.

This build adds one thing: an Add to Anki button. It comes from Mhs11294/educational-morphe-patches, a small community bundle whose only patch is this one. Tap it on a definition and the word goes to AnkiDroid as a new flashcard, which beats copying definitions over by hand if you study vocabulary with spaced repetition. Nothing else is changed, so ads and the paid upgrade are the same as in the regular app. The community AutoBuilds pipeline builds the APK with the Morphe CLI; it isn't from Merriam-Webster or the Morphe team.

What the patch does here

Add to Anki button

Sits next to the share button on each definition. One tap creates a card with the word and its definitions.

Works with AnkiDroid

The cards land in AnkiDroid, so you need that app installed. After that you review them like any other card.

Dictionary left alone

Definitions, examples and pronunciations are Merriam-Webster's own content. Ads and the premium upgrade aren't touched either.

Pinned to one release

The patch is written for a single app version, so this build can lag behind the Play Store until the bundle is updated.

Installing the dictionary

  1. Uninstall the Merriam-Webster app from the Play Store if you have it; the signatures don't match.
  2. Install AnkiDroid too if you don't have it yet, otherwise the new button has nothing to send cards to.
  3. Download the APK from the box above. It's a single universal file.
  4. Let your browser or file manager install unknown apps, then install it. Favourites and recent searches from the old install won't carry over.

Merriam-Webster build FAQ

Webster is just the short name used for this build. The app is the Merriam-Webster Dictionary for Android.

Yes, for the one thing the patch adds. The Add to Anki button hands the word and its definitions to AnkiDroid, so it has nowhere to send them without it. The dictionary works fine on its own either way.

apps.name: Morphe Windscribe

apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Windscribe?

Windscribe is a VPN from a Canadian company of the same name. The free plan gives you a monthly data allowance and a handful of server locations, and Pro removes the cap and opens up the full server list. It also has its own ad and tracker blocker, called R.O.B.E.R.T.

This APK was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Morphe CLI and the third-party rushiranpise/morphe-patches bundle, not the official Morphe patches. The bundle release used was a development pre-release. There's one Windscribe patch, Unlock Premium, applied by default, and its description just says it unlocks a Windscribe premium account. A VPN connects through Windscribe's own servers, so expect anything those servers enforce for your real account to still apply.

Morphe Windscribe Features

Unlock Premium

The only Windscribe patch in rushiranpise's bundle. It makes the app treat your account as premium.

Servers decide some things

The app can show Pro, but the VPN servers check your account too. Limits enforced there may not move.

Built from a dev release

The bundle version behind this build was a pre-release, so it may be rougher than a stable one.

Universal APK

One build for every architecture, nothing to choose.

How to Install Morphe Windscribe

  1. Uninstall Windscribe from the Play Store first. The signatures don't match, so Android won't install this APK on top of it.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps (Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps).
  4. Install it, log in to your Windscribe account and accept the VPN connection prompt the first time you connect.

Morphe Windscribe FAQ

Think about this one harder than most. It's an unofficial build: the community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original APK with Morphe CLI and rushiranpise's open-source morphe-patches bundle and re-signed it, without Windscribe or the Morphe team. A VPN app sees all of your traffic, so only install it if you really trust the source.

Maybe not. The patch unlocks premium in the app, but connections go through Windscribe's servers, which check your account. If they enforce the free plan, the patch can't change that.

The AutoBuilds pipeline used the bundle version that was current when it built this APK, and that was a development pre-release of rushiranpise's patches. Newer builds may switch to a stable release.

apps.name: Morphe Windy

apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Windy?

Windy, from the Czech company Windyty, is the forecast app with the animated wind flowing across the map. Sailors, paragliders and surfers like it because you can line up several forecast models against each other, ECMWF and GFS among them, and check waves, gusts, radar and satellite in the same place. Windy Premium adds more on top of the free app.

This build uses amfakh/fakh-patches, a community bundle that covers a long list of apps. For Windy it has two patches, both on by default. Premium unlock makes the app treat you as a Windy Pro subscriber, and GmsCore support gets "Log in with Google" working again on a re-signed APK. The community AutoBuilds pipeline builds it with the Morphe CLI. It's unofficial: not from Windyty and not from the Morphe team.

What changes in Windy

Premium unlock

The patch author lists deeper map zoom, 1-hour forecast steps, the premium calendar view and the other premium screens. The "Go Premium" button goes away.

Done inside the app

Windy's screens come from a JavaScript file shipped in the APK, and the patch edits that file. No fake purchase is sent anywhere, so the servers still see a free account.

Google login through microG RE

GmsCore support sends "Log in with Google" to microG RE instead of Google Play services. Without microG RE installed, the app shows a short note asking for it.

Universal APK

One APK that installs on any architecture.

Installing Windy

  1. Uninstall the Play Store version of Windy first, since this APK is signed with a different key.
  2. If you sign in with Google, install microG RE and add your Google account to it. Other ways of signing in don't need it.
  3. Download the APK above, allow installs from unknown sources for your browser or file manager, and open the file.
  4. Launch Windy, sign in if you use an account, and re-add your favourite spots if they don't sync back.

Windy FAQ

It's built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline from amfakh's open-source fakh-patches bundle. That makes it an unofficial, modified APK with the risks that come with that, so install it only if you trust that source.

No. The patch makes the app on your phone act as if you subscribe. Windy's servers still see a free account, so anything they decide on their side stays at the free level.
