apps.name: Morphe WPS Office
apps.description: WPS Office APK with GinArena's premium unlock: paid PDF, export, font and template tools, no ads. WPS login required. Community build.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe WPS Office?

WPS Office from Kingsoft is an office suite that handles Word documents, Excel sheets, PowerPoint decks and PDFs in a single app. It's a common pick on Android if you need to open or edit Office files without installing three separate Microsoft apps. Several tools, especially around PDFs, are part of WPS's paid Pro plan.

The patches now come from ginDoki19/GinArena-patch, a community bundle. Its Unlock premium features patch answers the app's payment checks with a yes, which opens the paid PDF, export, editing, font and template tools and stops ads from loading. You still have to be signed in to a WPS account for it to work. The community AutoBuilds pipeline builds the APK with the Morphe CLI, so it's unofficial: Kingsoft and the Morphe developers aren't involved.

What this WPS Office build does

Paid tools opened

PDF tools, export, editing, premium fonts and templates pass their ownership checks, and your account shows as Premium inside the app.

No ads

The same patch tells WPS you are ad-free, so banner and full-screen ads are never requested.

Fewer upgrade prompts

The upsell banner above the tool pages and the "already a member" popup are hidden.

Sign in first

Signed out, WPS reports no membership and the unlock has nothing to work with. Log in to your WPS account after installing.

AI is a weak spot

WPS AI depends on Kingsoft's servers, so don't expect it to work. An option that turns AI off, for tools that keep loading forever, exists but isn't on in this build.

No Google sign-in by default

Google login on a re-signed WPS needs GinArena's MicroG RE patch, which is off by default. Other WPS login methods work as usual.

Installing WPS Office

  1. Uninstall WPS Office from the Play Store if you have it. This APK is signed differently and won't install over it.
  2. Download the APK from the box above. The bundle author tested against the 64-bit ARM build of WPS for Android 10 and newer, so an older or 32-bit phone may not get along with it.
  3. Let your browser or file manager install unknown apps and install the file.
  4. Open WPS Office and sign in to your WPS account before you try the Pro tools.

WPS Office FAQ

It's built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline from ginDoki19's open-source GinArena-patch bundle. It's unofficial and modified, and an office app sees your documents, so install it only if you trust that source.

Yes. The patch author says to sign in first: while you're signed out, WPS reports no membership at all and there's nothing for the patch to switch over to Pro.

Probably not in this build. GinArena has a separate patch that routes Google sign-in through MicroG RE, but it's off by default and the automated build sticks to the defaults. Logging in to a WPS account another way isn't affected.

Don't count on it. WPS AI runs on Kingsoft's servers, which the patch can't change. The bundle even has an option to switch AI off for when an AI tool keeps loading forever, though it isn't on by default.

Files you saved to your phone's storage stay where they are. Files that only lived inside the app, or in a WPS cloud folder you haven't synced, are worth checking first.

apps.name: Morphe X
apps.description: X (Twitter) APK patched with crimera's Piko NewX bundle: promoted posts removed, inline downloads, keyword filters and full video quality. Community build.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe X?

X, still Twitter to plenty of people, has been moving its Android app to a rebuilt interface that the Piko project calls NewX. This page carries X with crimera/piko-newx, the bundle built from Piko's x-lite branch for that new interface. It's a community bundle for the Morphe patcher, not an official Morphe one, and the APK is produced by the community AutoBuilds pipeline.

Piko has been patching Twitter for a long time, and the default set here is big. You'll probably notice these first: promoted posts filtered out of timelines, a Download button under posts, the Premium upsell chip gone from the top bar, and video that stays at the best quality rather than dropping on mobile data. The version code is changed too, so the Play Store stops trying to update it.

What Piko NewX does to X

Promoted posts filtered

Promoted posts and modules are filtered out of timelines. The Premium upsell chip, Who to follow and Discover more sections can go as well.

Download button under posts

Saves photos, videos and GIFs to a folder you choose with your own filename pattern, and unlocks X's own download and offline video options.

Highest video quality

Playback always picks the best available video and audio stream instead of lowering quality to save bandwidth.

Filters for the timeline

Mute posts by keyword, limit For You to topics you pick, and hide posts marked as AI-generated or posts from selected verification types.

Menus your way

Reorder or hide bottom bar tabs, drawer items, post menu entries and action buttons. The Spaces bar, compose button and timeline tabs can be hidden too.

Timeline stays where you left it

No automatic jump to the top when you open the app, the new-posts pill can be hidden, and your scroll position is restored after the app restarts.

Themes and colors

Choose the original colors, Material You, high-contrast or Dim. The built-in color picker that normally needs Premium is unlocked.

Real links and small fixes

Open the real URL instead of t.co, share with a domain like fxtwitter, see poll results without voting, and view sensitive media without the extra tap.

How to install Morphe X

  1. Uninstall the official X app first. This build keeps X's package name but is signed differently, so it can't install on top.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above. It's a large file, so Wi-Fi helps.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, then open the APK and install it.
  4. Log in to your account and go through Piko's settings to choose which tweaks stay on.

Morphe X FAQ

It's X's own APK with crimera's open-source piko-newx bundle applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline rather than by this site or the Morphe developers. Modified apps carry risk, and X's terms don't allow them, so install it only if you trust the source and accept that.

NewX is the name Piko uses for X's rebuilt Android interface. The piko-newx bundle is made from Piko's x-lite branch specifically for that interface, which is why many patch names start with NewX.

No. A few things normally kept for Premium, like the app color picker and media downloads, are unlocked on your phone. Anything X checks on its servers, such as editing posts or longer posts, still needs a subscription.

No. The build has the same package name as the Play Store version, so the official app has to go first.

The Play Store won't, because Piko changes the version code to block store updates. Download the newer APK from this page and install it over the old one.

apps.name: Morphe Xodo

What is Morphe Xodo?

Xodo is a PDF app for reading, marking up and signing documents. It started out at PDFTron (now Apryse) and is run today by Xodo Technologies. You can highlight and comment, fill in forms, add a signature and reorganise pages, and some of the heavier tools are part of Xodo Pro.

The APK here has one extra patch, Enable Pro, from hoo-dles' community morphe-patches bundle (v1.47.0). It targets the features behind Xodo's subscription paywall. The hoo-dles repo on GitHub has been blocked, so the bundle is now mirrored on Codeberg by the AutoBuilds maintainer at RookieZ/campus-android-lab. Same patches, new home. The community AutoBuilds pipeline builds the APK with the Morphe CLI, so this is an unofficial build that Xodo and the Morphe team have nothing to do with.

Xodo build overview

Enable Pro

The bundle's only Xodo patch. It switches on the Pro features the app checks on your phone.

Same PDF tools

Reading, annotating, form filling and signing work like the official app. The patch doesn't change how files are saved.

Online services are separate

Anything Xodo runs on its own servers, or ties to a paid account, may still be limited.

Universal APK

One APK that installs on any architecture.

How to install Xodo

  1. Uninstall Xodo from the Play Store first. Android won't install a differently signed copy on top of it.
  2. Download the APK from the box above.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, then install it.
  4. Open Xodo and give it access to your files so it can find your PDFs.

Xodo FAQ

The community AutoBuilds pipeline builds it from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches, using the Codeberg mirror since the GitHub original was blocked. It's not an official Xodo or Morphe release, and modified APKs carry some risk. Only install it if you trust that source.

apps.name: Morphe XRecorder
apps.description: XRecorder APK with rimixyz's patches: Pro unlocked on-device, no app-open ads, analytics off. The Edit tab crashes for now. Community build.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe XRecorder?

XRecorder is InShot's screen recorder. A small floating button sits at the edge of the screen; tap it to start, stop or take a screenshot. It can record internal audio on Android versions that allow it, overlay your front camera, and trim the result in its built-in editor. It's free with ads, and InShot sells a Pro upgrade.

This build is patched with rimixyz/morphe-patches, a personal community bundle (not official Morphe, despite the repo name). Four of its patches apply to XRecorder: Unlock Pro, Disable ads, Disable analytics and tracking and Disable remote config. There's one catch the author is open about: the Edit tab closes while loading its video engine, so the built-in editor doesn't work right now. The community AutoBuilds pipeline builds the APK with the Morphe CLI; InShot and the Morphe team aren't involved.

What the patches change

Unlock Pro

Switches on XRecorder's local Pro state, which takes care of the paywall, locked options and ads. Server-side AI, credits and quotas aren't included.

Disable ads

Stops the ad that loads when the app opens. The ad SDK still starts, because the splash screen needs it.

No analytics or tracking

Turns off Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics and drops the advertising ID permission.

Remote config frozen

InShot can't push new ad settings or a different server domain to the app through Firebase Remote Config.

Editor is broken for now

The Edit tab closes while it loads the native video engine. Recording, the floating button and screenshots work fine.

Universal APK

There's only a universal build, so it's one download for any phone.

Installing XRecorder

  1. Uninstall the Play Store XRecorder if you have it. This APK has a different signature.
  2. Download the APK from the box above and allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps.
  3. Install it, then allow the overlay permission so the floating button can appear.
  4. Start your first recording and accept Android's screen-capture prompt.

XRecorder FAQ

It's built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline from rimixyz's open-source morphe-patches bundle, whose README says the patches are written with AI and tested on a real device before release. It's still an unofficial, modified APK, and a screen recorder can see whatever is on your screen, so install it only if you trust that source.

It's a known issue the patch author lists on every XRecorder patch: the Edit tab closes while it loads the video engine. Screen recording itself works. If you need the editor, trim your clips in another app for now.

No. Unlock Pro only changes the Pro state stored on your phone. AI features, credits and quotas, and subscription checks all run on InShot's servers and stay as they are.

Videos saved to your phone's shared storage normally stay after you uninstall. The app's settings are reset.

Android lets each app block internal audio capture, and older Android versions don't support it at all. That's an Android limit, not something the patches change.

apps.name: Morphe YouTube
apps.description: Morphe YouTube APK with the official Morphe patches: ads hidden, background play, SponsorBlock and Return YouTube Dislike. Sign-in needs MicroG RE.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe YouTube?

Most of what bugs people about YouTube on Android is the same short list: an ad before nearly every video, Premium banners, a Shorts shelf in the middle of the home feed, and audio that cuts out the moment you switch apps. This is the regular YouTube app with the official Morphe patches (MorpheApp/morphe-patches) already applied, so you get those fixes without running Morphe Manager yourself.

The APK is built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. Neither the Morphe developers nor this site build it; we link to the file and refresh that link several times a day. The build uses Morphe's default patch selection for YouTube, which is nearly the whole list. Almost every patch adds a switch instead of forcing a change, so the first thing to do after installing is open YouTube's settings, find the Morphe section and go through it.

What the Morphe patches add to YouTube

Ads and Premium nags hidden

The Hide ads patch covers video ads, feed ads and Premium promotions. If there's a creator you want to support, Channel whitelist lets ads back in on that channel only.

Background playback

Audio keeps going with the screen off or when you leave the app, kids videos included. A picture-in-picture button can also be added to the player.

SponsorBlock built in

Skips sponsor reads and other segments marked by the SponsorBlock community. You decide which kinds get skipped automatically and which just show up on the seekbar.

Dislikes and honest titles

Return YouTube Dislike shows an estimated dislike count again. DeArrow can replace clickbait titles and thumbnails, and Restore original titles stops YouTube from auto-translating them.

Shorts on your terms

Hide the Shorts shelf in feeds, drop the Shorts button from the bottom bar, or open Shorts in the normal player where you can seek and change speed.

Player defaults that stick

Set a default video quality and playback speed, add swipe controls for volume and brightness, put a loop button in the player, and get rid of the Continue watching? pause.

Downloads through another app

The download button can hand a video to an external downloader you have installed. The patch doesn't save files itself, so you'll need such an app.

A tidier watch page

Hide end screen cards, info cards, related videos or single buttons under the player. Shared links also lose their tracking parameters.

Installing Morphe YouTube

  1. Install MicroG RE first. This build includes Morphe's GmsCore support patch, which means the app talks to microG instead of Google Play Services. Without it you can't sign in to your Google account. This MicroG RE guide covers which file to pick and what to do if sign-in fails.
  2. Download the APK from the box above. There's a single Universal file, so there's nothing to pick.
  3. Open it and let your browser or file manager install unknown apps when Android asks, then tap Install.
  4. Open the app, sign in through MicroG, then find the Morphe section in YouTube's settings and choose what you want turned on.

The GmsCore patch also gives the app its own package name, so it installs next to the stock YouTube instead of replacing it. If Android still refuses, you most likely have an older patched YouTube signed with a different key; uninstall that one and try again. Many people disable the stock YouTube app afterwards so links open in the patched one.

Morphe YouTube FAQ

It's the normal YouTube APK with the open-source MorpheApp/morphe-patches bundle applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline rather than by this site or the Morphe developers. Every patch is public on GitHub, but any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust where it comes from.

Because the app is re-signed and renamed, it can't use Google Play Services for your account. The GmsCore support patch points it at microG instead, and MicroG RE is the build Morphe maintains. Install it even if you plan to watch logged out, since the patched app expects it to be there.

No. Ads are hidden and background play works on your phone, but your Google account doesn't get a Premium subscription. Anything YouTube checks on its own servers stays exactly as it is.

YouTube changes its playback checks every so often. The build includes the Spoof video streams patch, and changing its client option in the Morphe settings is the usual first fix. If nothing helps, wait for a newer build to show up here.

Not through the Play Store, which sees it as a different app. Download the newer APK here and install it over the old one. If Android refuses because the signature changed, uninstall the old copy first; you'll have to sign in again.

apps.name: Morphe YouTube Music
apps.description: Morphe YouTube Music APK with the official Morphe patches: no ads, screen-off playback, synced lyrics and Last.fm scrobbling. ARM64 and ARMv7 builds.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe YouTube Music?

YouTube Music is Google's app for songs, albums and podcasts. On a free account it plays ads between tracks and stops as soon as the screen goes off, and fixing those two things is most of what this build is for. It's the stock app with the official Morphe patches applied by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. This site only links to the APK.

Beyond the basics there are some nice extras: a proper crossfade between tracks, synced lyrics pulled from third-party providers, scrobbling to Last.fm or ListenBrainz, and an option to play the song version of an album track rather than its music video. Nearly all of it lives behind switches in the Morphe settings, so you can leave alone whatever you don't care about.

What's different in Morphe YouTube Music

No ads between songs

Fullscreen ads, video ads and the Premium promotions are hidden by the Hide ads patch.

Keeps playing with the screen off

Background playback restrictions are removed, and audio-only mode lets you play a track without loading its video.

Synced lyrics

The Third-party lyrics patch fills the lyrics panel with time-synced lyrics from outside providers, which helps a lot for tracks where YouTube has none.

Scrobbling

Send what you play to Last.fm or ListenBrainz straight from the app, no separate scrobbler needed.

Crossfade and saner queues

A dual-player crossfade between tracks, shuffle and repeat that stay how you left them, and an option to play just the tapped song instead of replacing your queue with the whole album.

Android Auto

How to install it

  1. Install MicroG RE. The build includes the GmsCore support patch, so your Google sign-in goes through microG. If you haven't set it up before, follow the MicroG RE sign-in guide.
  2. Pick the right APK. There's no Universal file for YouTube Music, only ARM64 and ARMv7. Almost every phone sold in recent years needs ARM64. Choose ARMv7 only for an older or low-end device running 32-bit Android. x86 devices and most PC emulators aren't covered by either file.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, then open the APK and install it. Its package name differs from the stock app, so the two can sit side by side.
  4. Sign in through MicroG, then open YouTube Music's settings and look for the Morphe section.
